title: XMLELEMENT (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name, XMLELEMENT("Para",Name) AS ExportName FROM Sample.Person
SELECT DISTINCT XMLELEMENT(NAME "Address",Home_City,' ',Home_State) AS CityState FROM Sample.Person ORDER BY Home_City
SELECT XMLELEMENT("Para",Name) AS XMLNotes,XMLELEMENT("Para",Notes) AS XMLText FROM Sample.Employee
SELECT XMLELEMENT("Para",Name,DOB, XMLELEMENT("Emphasis",%ID),Age, (SELECT XMLELEMENT("NameSub",Name) FROM Sample.Person WHERE %ID=2)) AS ExportName FROM Sample.Person WHERE %ID=1
SELECT XMLELEMENT("Para",Home_State, XMLELEMENT("Para",Name), CASE WHEN Age < 21 THEN NULL ELSE XMLELEMENT("Para",Age) END ) FROM Sample.Person
SELECT XMLELEMENT("Para",XMLATTRIBUTES(%ID AS ItemKey),Name) FROM Sample.Person
SELECT DISTINCT XMLELEMENT(NAME,Home_City,' ',Home_State) AS CityState FROM Sample.Person ORDER BY Home_City
